The structure of Mg3Ti9O24 (MgTi3O8) crystallizes in the trigonal R-3m space group (No. 166), with 36 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Ti centers each coordinated by six O neighbors in octahedral motifs, while O centers adopt three- and four-neighbor environments. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 36 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate edge-sharing between Mg–Ti and Ti–Ti octahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among O-centered polyhedra.
